title: failed to register application for bluetooth scan during reconnect to BlueJay watch
body:
After the bluejay was in range of the phone, no values were transfered to the xDrip. A scan in the BlueJay Admin panel is not successfull and prints the following error to the log:

```
2020-09-18 23:24:52.230 com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip W/ScanMeister: Failed to register application for bluetooth scan
                        com.polidea.rxandroidble2.exceptions.BleScanException: Scan failed because application registration failed (code 6)
```

comments.body: Sending the log terminates with error: `Error sending feedback: ` (no response message).
The scan works after disabling and enabling bluetooth but neither the transmitter status nor values were received from the BlueJay. After rebooting the phone, connection works without any problems.

Here is are the log entries from the database export:

```
_id	message
39189	called with string ScanMeister:v
39190	Adding tag with VERBOSE ScanMeister
39191	No valid timestamp stored for transmitter: 8H0K2U
39192	stopScan called from: Scan start
39193	startScan called: hunting: null null
39194	Overriding with custom filter
39195	onScanFailure: com.polidea.rxandroidble2.exceptions.BleScanException: Scan failed because application registration failed (code 6)
39196	Failed to register application for bluetooth scan com.polidea.rxandroidble2.exceptions.BleScanException: Scan failed because application registration failed (code 6)
39197	Scan failure: Failed to register application for bluetooth scan
39198	Processing callbacks for NULL SCAN_FAILED
39199	Callback2: ThinJamActivity
39200	stopScan called from: Scan failure
39201	stopScan stopped scan
39202	Aggressively restarting collector service due to lack of reception: backoff: 300
```

Hello!
Xdrip aacd466b0-2020.06.16 code 2006160054
Libre Honor 7s
The phone stopped to receive data.
After 2 hours I tried to restart collector but it started to work only after I restarted phone.
I've noticed error: scan failed. 
In app log: "scan meister: failed to register application for Bluetooth scan"

This probably means the bluetooth of your android phone has crashed, a restart is often the only way to fix it. There isn't a great deal I can do to help with this in the application I don't think. Which Android version is your phone running?

Android 8.1.0 Honor 7s

I don't understand,... Can you help with this situation?
When I switch off BT scanning, there is no problem with getting data

I'm on Android 8.1 with LineageOS an a Samsung Galaxy S4 mini. It worked a long time (February - April) without any problem. After Corona lockdown and all nightly updates (now on 2009212340) it does not work anymore, if the connection is lost for about more than an hour during watch not in range. Previously, phone and bluejay connected automaticaly after they were in range.
I did not perform any LineageOS updates for two years. Hence, it is likely a problem with xDrip. I'll investigate this deeper and also try to downgrade to version 2020.02.19.

@tolot27 Can you verify if you can resolve the problem by going back to a previous version of xDrip?
If not, can we remove the bug label please?
